source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 28 (non-standard employment, at least 5 hours per day, earns more than R394 that day: 25% deduction); p. 28 "calculated and deducted at 25% on the balance of remuneration"
notes: Non-standard employment, 6 hours a day at R500 a day for 10 days = R5 000. Over R394 a day, so 25% of the balance of remuneration: R1 250.00 (G21 p. 28, summary table row 4). The tables give nil (60 000 is under the threshold). Only PAYE is asserted. Complements sage-2027-03-marco (Sage's flat 25% with no hours). G21 p. 28 reading used by all the ts-* cases: the deemed-standard bullet has two limbs, (1) under 22 hours a week with a written declaration of no other employer, and (2) at least 5 hours a day and paid under R394 a day, read as an alternative route to deemed standard; the summary-table rows for non-standard employment follow from that (row 5, under 5 hours a day and under R394, is the residual non-standard case taxed at 25%, not a misprint). TS-b must wire taxStatus and the hours into runCase (oracle.ts hard-codes employmentType permanent and passes no taxStatus or unmodelled input today, so this case cannot see them); once wired, this case must go red if the status is ignored.
